nodes.name: NeurIPS-2022-amortized-inference-for-heterogeneous-reconstruction-in-cryo-em-Paper-Conference.txt
nodes.summary: First-page text from the NeurIPS 2022 cryoFIRE paper, presenting amortized joint inference of particle poses and conformations with a physics-based decoder for heterogeneous cryo-EM reconstruction. It motivates the method through the computational difficulty of recovering dynamic 3D structures from millions of noisy, randomly oriented projections.

nodes.name: NeurIPS-2024-cryospin-improving-ab-initio-cryo-em-reconstruction-with-semi-amortized-pose-inference-Paper-Conference.txt
nodes.summary: First-page text from the NeurIPS 2024 cryoSPIN paper, which combines amortized pose prediction with local auto-decoding and stochastic-gradient pose refinement for ab initio cryo-EM reconstruction. The abstract reports improved handling of multimodal pose distributions, faster convergence, and better experimental reconstruction quality than cryoAI.

nodes.name: nmeth.4169.txt
nodes.summary: Opening text of the 2017 Nature Methods cryoSPARC article describing rapid, unsupervised cryo-EM structure determination through stochastic gradient descent and branch-and-bound maximum-likelihood optimization. It emphasizes automated ab initio 3D classification, GPU acceleration, reduced expert intervention, and desktop-scale processing times.

nodes.name: s41592-025-02819-8.txt
nodes.summary: First-page text of a paper on sparse Fourier backpropagation for cryo-EM, replacing coordinate-based neural volume representations with a volumetric grid and exploiting sparse Fourier projection operations during training. The approach targets lower computational cost and interactive latent-space analysis while preserving or improving reconstruction quality.
